ERESOLVE.meaning: npm cannot resolve dependency tree — conflicting peer or version requirements
fix_steps: Read the conflict above the ERESOLVE line
As last resort: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install

E401.meaning: Unauthorized — bad or missing npm auth token

E403.meaning: Forbidden — no access to this package or registry
fix_steps: Request access to the private package

EACCES.meaning: Permission denied writing to node_modules or cache
fix_steps: Fix ownership of ~/.npm and project dir

ELIFECYCLE.meaning: Script failed — a package lifecycle script (postinstall, build, etc.) exited non-zero
fix_steps: Scroll up for the actual error in the script output
Check native deps (node-gyp, python) if postinstall builds binaries

ENOENT.meaning: npm expected a file that doesn't exist

ETARGET.meaning: No matching version found for a dependency range
fix_steps: Loosen or fix the version range in package.json
